intention: Stage 4 of the /chart chain: the DECOMPOSE brick. One narrow question: how does this request SPLIT? Not what is asked (orient), not what bounds it (constrain), not what exists (survey) — the pieces: SUB_PROBLEMS, each carrying its what, its why, and its KIND — 'compose' (uses holdings the survey berth carries, by address) or 'build' (fills an absence the survey measured, verbatim). Three strata: FLOOR — template-filled from the berthed survey packet (the chain deepens to depth 4: decompose -> survey -> constrain -> orient, re-checked whole by composing survey's own chain reader — one implementation, not a parallel walk), it hands the ceiling the intent, the bounds, and the exact compose/build VOCABULARIES the judges will enforce (holdings addresses, absence whats); TREE — the decompose brick's own corpus through the generalized verbs; CEILING — assembles the split with per-field provenance. Built UNDER the pre-installed judges (ticket decompose-filters): the berth door composes judge_decompose by identity; the module cannot shape its own acceptance.
why: Decompose is where a builder either derives the work from the chain or invents it. The dated failures are split-shaped: the 2026-07-24 done-while-unmoved substitution (a decomposition that dropped the expensive piece the chosen path implied and delivered a cheaper invented one) and stone 1's parallel roster (a piece built where a holding sat unreferenced). The kind field makes each piece's claim challengeable, and the floor's vocabularies make the honest split the path of least resistance: template-fill as physics — the ceiling receives exactly the words the judges will check. This is also /sail step 2 compiled one rung down the ladder: 'holdings are what you COMPOSE, absences are what you may BUILD' stops being skill prose and becomes the packet's schema.

THE CHAIN PUSHES BACK UP: a piece that needs something the survey does not hold is refused — the honest cure is re-surveying (the holding gets measured in), not widening the split. Upstream completeness enforced from downstream.

BUILT BY THE SKILL IT FEEDS: this stone was delivered inside the first real /sail crossing — /chart charted the decompose build, /sail sailed it, and the new stage extends the very chain /sail fills from. Dogfood in both directions, same day.
